record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce tied item embedding width and matching hidden width from 48 to 40, propagating only required tensor-shape changes. Since width 64 regressed, modestly reduced capacity may regularize sparse item representations while preserving beneficial input/output sharing. Keep initialization scheme, features, causal block structure, history/readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Save width metadata and ensure the predictor writer reconstructs the matching single model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Reduce tied item embedding and matching hidden width from 48 to 40 across all four datasets to test modest capacity regularization. Existing dimension-dependent layers, saved hidden_units metadata, and metadata-backed predictor construction propagate the new width consistently. Preserve causal blocks, features, readout, scoring, loss, optimizer, and one checkpoint per dataset.
